local_sufficiency_validation.basis: Large-source guideline guardrail and stable recent-project pattern. Extracted guideline guidance uses atom_kind 'other', with recommendation/practice-point type recorded in tags; no primary-study result was attributed to the guideline.

cross_batch_inconsistencies: The eGFR threshold in Recommendation 10.2.3.1.1 conflicts with Figure 5. The atom preserves and flags the conflict rather than repairing it.

extraction_limitations: The current LiteratureAtom model has no dedicated guideline_recommendation atom kind. Formal guidance is represented with atom_kind 'other' and descriptive tags.
Primary-study effect estimates summarized by the guideline and data supplement were used for SEA appraisal but were not converted into primary-study LiteratureAtoms.
